final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS ls, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS a, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mu FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_kept, SUM(g.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(g.a - m.mu) AS avg_excess FROM g, m WHERE g.a > m.mu
